card_lines: Next Compass tier needs: Elemental Path 12 -> 15, Abominations Slain 16 -> 19, Medallions Collected 28 -> 39.
Elemental Path's next level costs 13.1M stardust, you're 3.87M short.
18 upgrades cost almost nothing right now, just buy them: Stone Failsafe, Jade Coinage, Critter Culture, Moondust Hoarding, Tempest Heartbeat, Tempest Defence.
Your call: Exalted Stamps (2B stardust) gives one more stamp exalt, but it delays Elemental Path by the same amount. Griffy uses moons for an extra exalt.
Kill Bobo the Fractured next (Waterlogged Entrance). It's abomination #17 and it lets Tempest Form into the W3 town.
Print day: Moon of Print is 102 of 200, next level 385K stardust.
Griffy: farm every medallion and kill every abomination.
